properties.description: Starts a Cisco Repository firmware upgrade for one Server, UCS-X Chassis, or Domain, optionally with five polls. Select a target authorized to read organizations, inventory, firmware catalog/status and create the upgrade. It validates exact identity/cardinality, relationships, two distinct Domain Fabric Interconnects, image tags/placement, ExcludeComponentPidList, and switch WaitTimeOut. Final preflight blocks NONE/IN_PROGRESS but can race create. v1 accepts only Cisco Repository and no credentials. HTTP 200 means accepted, not complete, unless status is SUCCESSFUL; polling is limited to five attempts within 1-600 seconds. OpenAPI does not prove eCMC support, so that route fails closed. UCS-X tags and Domain FabricSwitch Release selection require live-tenant validation; softwarerepository.Release is deprecated with sunset 2027-02-20. Inspect before retrying an ambiguous result. The bounded poller is inlined in this standalone export; no embedded workflow import is required.

properties.name: Target Type
properties.description: Required exact target family: Domain, UCS-X Chassis, Unified Edge Chassis (eCMC), or Server. No production target is preselected.

properties.name: Device Organization
properties.description: Exact Cisco Intersight organization used to scope target resolution.

properties.name: Target Name
properties.description: Exact organization-scoped server, UCS-X chassis, eCMC, or domain name. No production identity is prepopulated.

properties.name: Firmware Version
properties.description: Exact Cisco repository catalog version. No production firmware version is prepopulated.

properties.name: Image Source
properties.description: Image source. Initial v1 accepts only Cisco Repository and never accepts repository credentials.

properties.name: Server Upgrade Mode
properties.description: Server-only mode: Start Immediately maps to upgrade_full and Mount Only maps to upgrade_mount_only. Other target types must keep Start Immediately.

properties.name: Skip Estimate Impact
properties.description: Server-only option passed as SkipEstimateImpact. Other target types must keep false.

properties.name: Excluded Components
properties.description: Optional JSON string array. Server values: none, local-disk, drives-except-boot-drives, storage-controller, storage-sasexpander, storage-u2. UCS-X values: none, local-disk, psu, xfm. Domain/eCMC require empty input.

properties.name: Excluded Component PIDs
properties.description: Optional server-only JSON object with only ExcludeLocalDiskList and/or ExcludeStorageControllerList string arrays. Chassis and switch upgrades reject this input.

properties.name: XFM Upgrade Option
properties.description: UCS-X chassis-only value: none, full-shutdown, or partial-shutdown. Other target types must keep none.

properties.name: Enable Fabric Evacuation
properties.description: Domain/eCMC switch-upgrade option. Server and UCS-X chassis routes must keep true.

properties.name: Switch Wait Timeout Minutes
properties.description: Domain/eCMC WaitTimeOut from -1 through 1000. The numeric default 0 is sent explicitly so the switch upgrade starts immediately; omission would invoke API default -1/manual acknowledgement.

properties.name: Enable PSU Upgrade
properties.description: Domain/eCMC switch-upgrade option. Server and UCS-X chassis routes must keep false.

properties.name: Enable PDB FPGA Upgrade
properties.description: Domain/eCMC switch-upgrade option. Server and UCS-X chassis routes must keep false.

properties.name: Skip Wait for I/O Connectivity
properties.description: Domain/eCMC option mapped to OpenAPI field SkipWaitForIoPathConnectivity. Server and UCS-X chassis routes must keep false.

properties.name: Wait for Completion
properties.description: When false, report the documented HTTP 200 accepted resource without claiming upgrade completion. When true, poll a validated UpgradeStatus or created resource at most five times.

properties.name: Wait Timeout Seconds
properties.description: Required from 1 through 600 when Wait for Completion is true; otherwise must remain numeric 0.

properties.name: Status Code
properties.description: HTTP-style final status. Documented successful firmware create and completed wait paths use 200; validation/lookup/readiness failures use 4xx; helper/API/polling failures use 5xx.

properties.name: Status Message
properties.description: Human-readable outcome distinguishing an accepted firmware resource from a confirmed completed upgrade.

properties.name: Error Message
properties.description: Actionable failure detail. Empty only for a validated accepted or completed result.

properties.name: Result
properties.description: Structured JSON with exact organization, target, image, submitted resource, accepted-versus-completed state, and explicit tenant-readiness caveats.

properties.name: Polling Attempt
properties.description: Tracks the current bounded firmware upgrade status poll from 1 through 5.

properties.name: Last Firmware Poll Result
properties.description: Caches the latest validated nonterminal firmware poll result for the exhaustion path outside the bounded loop.

import json
import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
expectedName = sys.argv[2]

    raise ValueError("Organization response is missing a Results array")

    organizationStatus = "not-found"
    organizationMessage = "No exact organization matched Device Organization."
elif len(values) > 1:
    organizationStatus = "ambiguous"
    organizationMessage = "Multiple organizations matched Device Organization."
else:
    item = values[0]
    moid = str(item.get("Moid") or "") if isinstance(item, dict) else ""
    if not isinstance(item, dict) or item.get("Name") != expectedName or item.get("ObjectType") != "organization.Organization" or item.get("ClassId") != "organization.Organization" or not re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", moid):
        organizationStatus = "invalid"
        organizationMessage = "The organization response has an invalid exact name, discriminator, or URL-safe Moid."
    else:
        organizationStatus = "exact"
        organizationMoid = moid
        organizationMessage = "Exactly one organization identity was validated."
organizationResultJson = json.dumps({"status": organizationStatus, "message": organizationMessage, "organizationMoid": organizationMoid or None}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = organizationStatus in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid", "exact") and bool(organizationMessage and organizationResultJson) and (organizationStatus != "exact" or bool(organizationMoid))

properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
targetType = sys.argv[2]
expectedName = sys.argv[3]
organizationMoid = sys.argv[4]
expectedObjectType = sys.argv[5]
firmwareVersion = sys.argv[6]
escapedFirmwareVersion = sys.argv[7]
values = payload.get("Results")
if not isinstance(values, list):
    raise ValueError("Target response is missing a Results array")

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", value) is not None

def relation_matches(rel, moid, objectType):
    return isinstance(rel, dict) and rel.get("Moid") == moid and rel.get("ObjectType") == objectType and rel.get("ClassId") in (None, "mo.MoRef", objectType)

targetMoid = ""
targetModel = ""
sourceObjectType = ""
managementMode = ""
distributableType = ""
networkElements = []
imageApiUrl = ""
imageObjectType = ""
activeUpgradeApiUrl = ""
readinessCaveats = []

if len(values) == 0:
    targetStatus = "not-found"
    targetMessage = "No exact organization-scoped target matched Target Name."
elif len(values) > 1:
    targetStatus = "ambiguous"
    targetMessage = "Multiple organization-scoped targets matched Target Name."
else:
    item = values[0]
    problems = []
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        problems.append("Target result is not an object.")
    else:
        moid = str(item.get("Moid") or "")
        permissions = item.get("PermissionResources")
        matches = [r for r in permissions if relation_matches(r, organizationMoid, "organization.Organization")] if isinstance(permissions, list) else []
        if not safe_moid(moid):
            problems.append("Target Moid is missing or not URL-safe.")
        if item.get("Name") != expectedName:
            problems.append("Target Name does not exactly match the requested name.")
        if item.get("ObjectType") != expectedObjectType or item.get("ClassId") != expectedObjectType:
            problems.append("Target discriminators do not match the selected target route.")
        if len(matches) != 1:
            problems.append("Target must contain exactly one matching organization permission relationship.")

        if targetType == "Server":
            model = item.get("Model")
            mode = item.get("ManagementMode")
            source = item.get("SourceObjectType")
            if not isinstance(model, str) or not model:
                problems.append("PhysicalSummary Model is required for image compatibility.")
            if mode not in ("Intersight", "IntersightStandalone", "UCSM"):
                problems.append("PhysicalSummary ManagementMode is not a documented server mode.")
            if source not in ("compute.Blade", "compute.RackUnit"):
                problems.append("PhysicalSummary SourceObjectType must be concrete compute.Blade or compute.RackUnit.")
            if mode in ("Intersight", "IntersightStandalone"):
                distributableType = "IMMHOST"
            elif mode == "UCSM" and source == "compute.Blade":
                distributableType = "UMMBLADE"
            elif mode == "UCSM" and source == "compute.RackUnit":
                distributableType = "UMMRACK"
            targetModel = model or ""
            managementMode = mode or ""
            sourceObjectType = source or ""
            imageObjectType = "firmware.Distributable"
            imageApiUrl = "/api/v1/firmware/Distributables?$filter=Version eq '" + escapedFirmwareVersion + "'&$select=Moid,Version,Model,SupportedModels,ImageType,PlatformType,Vendor,Origin,ObjectType,ClassId,Tags"
            activeUpgradeApiUrl = "/api/v1/firmware/Upgrades?$filter=Server.Moid eq '" + moid + "'&$select=Moid,Status,ObjectType,ClassId,Server"
        elif targetType == "UCS-X Chassis":
            model = item.get("Model")
            platform = item.get("PlatformType")
            if not isinstance(model, str) or not model.startswith("UCSX-"):
                problems.append("UCS-X Chassis requires an exact equipment.Chassis Model beginning UCSX-; schema does not expose a stronger UCS-X discriminator.")
            if platform is not None and not isinstance(platform, str):
                problems.append("Chassis PlatformType must be a string when returned.")
            targetModel = model or ""
            imageObjectType = "firmware.Distributable"
            imageApiUrl = "/api/v1/firmware/Distributables?$filter=Version eq '" + escapedFirmwareVersion + "'&$select=Moid,Version,Model,SupportedModels,ImageType,PlatformType,Vendor,Origin,ObjectType,ClassId,Tags"
            activeUpgradeApiUrl = "/api/v1/firmware/ChassisUpgrades?$filter=Chassis.Moid eq '" + moid + "'&$select=Moid,Status,ObjectType,ClassId,Chassis"
            readinessCaveats.append("UCS-X chassis catalog tag vocabulary is not defined by OpenAPI and requires live-tenant validation; this workflow requires exact model compatibility and the Cisco cloud repository tag before mutation.")
        elif targetType == "Unified Edge Chassis (eCMC)":
            model = item.get("Model")
            if not isinstance(model, str) or not model:
                problems.append("eCMC Model is required for any future image compatibility mapping.")
            if item.get("SwitchType") != "EdgeChassisManagementController":
                problems.append("eCMC target must return SwitchType EdgeChassisManagementController.")
            targetModel = model or ""
            readinessCaveats.append("The current OpenAPI describes firmware.SwitchUpgrade as a Fabric Interconnect operation and does not prove the eCMC image relationship. This branch intentionally fails closed before image lookup or mutation pending live-tenant validation.")
        elif targetType == "Domain":
            expanded = item.get("NetworkElements")
            if not isinstance(expanded, list) or len(expanded) != 2:
                problems.append("Domain must expand exactly two NetworkElements.")
            else:
                seenMoids = set()
                seenSwitchIds = set()
                for element in expanded:
                    if not isinstance(element, dict):
                        problems.append("Every expanded domain NetworkElement must be an object.")
                        continue
                    elementMoid = element.get("Moid")
                    elementModel = element.get("Model")
                    switchId = element.get("SwitchId")
                    if not safe_moid(elementMoid) or elementMoid in seenMoids:
                        problems.append("Domain NetworkElements must have two distinct URL-safe Moids.")
                    if element.get("ObjectType") != "network.Element" or element.get("ClassId") != "network.Element":
                        problems.append("Expanded domain NetworkElement discriminators are invalid.")
                    if element.get("SwitchType") != "FabricInterconnect":
                        problems.append("Both domain NetworkElements must be FabricInterconnect elements.")
                    if switchId not in ("A", "B") or switchId in seenSwitchIds:
                        problems.append("Domain NetworkElements must identify distinct fabric A and B elements.")
                    if not isinstance(elementModel, str) or not elementModel:
                        problems.append("Each domain NetworkElement requires Model for release compatibility.")
                    seenMoids.add(elementMoid)
                    seenSwitchIds.add(switchId)
                if seenSwitchIds != {"A", "B"}:
                    problems.append("Domain must contain exactly fabric A and fabric B.")
                networkElements = sorted(expanded, key=lambda e: str(e.get("SwitchId")))
                targetModel = ",".join(str(e.get("Model") or "") for e in networkElements)
                if len(networkElements) == 2 and all(safe_moid(e.get("Moid")) for e in networkElements):
                    activeUpgradeApiUrl = "/api/v1/firmware/SwitchUpgrades?$filter=NetworkElements/any(n:n/Moid eq '" + networkElements[0]["Moid"] + "') and NetworkElements/any(n:n/Moid eq '" + networkElements[1]["Moid"] + "')&$select=Moid,Status,ObjectType,ClassId,NetworkElements"
            imageObjectType = "softwarerepository.Release"
            imageApiUrl = "/api/v1/softwarerepository/Releases?$filter=Version eq '" + escapedFirmwareVersion + "' and Type eq 'FabricSwitch'&$select=Moid,Version,Type,SupportedModels,ObjectType,ClassId"
            readinessCaveats.append("Domain Release-versus-Distributable selection requires live-tenant validation. This v1 uses only an exact model-compatible FabricSwitch Release and places it only in firmware.SwitchUpgrade.Release. softwarerepository.Release is deprecated with OpenAPI sunset 2027-02-20.")

    if problems:
        targetStatus = "invalid"
        targetMessage = " ".join(problems)
    elif targetType == "Unified Edge Chassis (eCMC)":
        targetStatus = "unsupported"
        targetMoid = item["Moid"]
        targetMessage = "Exact eCMC target was validated, but the unproven eCMC SwitchUpgrade/image mapping is intentionally blocked before mutation."
    else:
        targetStatus = "exact"
        targetMoid = item["Moid"]
        targetMessage = "Exactly one organization-scoped firmware target and all branch-specific relationships were validated."

targetResultJson = json.dumps({
    "status": targetStatus,
    "message": targetMessage,
    "targetType": targetType,
    "targetName": expectedName,
    "targetMoid": targetMoid or None,
    "targetObjectType": expectedObjectType,
    "targetModel": targetModel or None,
    "managementMode": managementMode or None,
    "sourceObjectType": sourceObjectType or None,
    "distributableType": distributableType or None,
    "networkElements": networkElements,
    "activeUpgradeApiUrl": activeUpgradeApiUrl or None,
    "firmwareVersion": firmwareVersion,
    "readinessCaveats": readinessCaveats
}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = targetStatus in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid", "unsupported", "exact") and bool(targetMessage and targetResultJson) and (targetStatus not in ("exact", "unsupported") or bool(targetMoid)) and (targetStatus != "exact" or bool(imageApiUrl and imageObjectType and activeUpgradeApiUrl))

actions.title: Inspect image compatibility and build typed upgrade request

properties.description: Requires exactly one compatible image. Server enforces model plus documented distributable/repository tags; UCS-X enforces model plus Cisco cloud repository tag and records its tenant catalog-tag caveat; Domain enforces one FabricSwitch Release supporting both FI models. It builds exact discriminators, relationships, DirectDownload enums, Release-versus-Distributable placement, PID object shape, and explicitly includes WaitTimeOut including numeric 0.
properties.display_name: Inspect image compatibility and build typed upgrade request
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
target = json.loads(sys.argv[2])
prepared = json.loads(sys.argv[3])
values = payload.get("Results")
if not isinstance(values, list):
    raise ValueError("Firmware image response is missing a Results array")

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", value) is not None

def tag_pairs(item):
    tags = item.get("Tags")
    if not isinstance(tags, list):
        return set()
    return {(tag.get("Key"), tag.get("Value")) for tag in tags if isinstance(tag, dict) and isinstance(tag.get("Key"), str) and isinstance(tag.get("Value"), str)}

targetType = prepared.get("targetType")
firmwareVersion = prepared.get("firmwareVersion")
targetMoid = target.get("targetMoid")
targetModel = target.get("targetModel")
targetObjectType = target.get("targetObjectType")
sourceObjectType = target.get("sourceObjectType")
compatible = []
schemaProblems = []
for index, item in enumerate(values):
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        schemaProblems.append("Catalog result " + str(index) + " is not an object.")
        continue
    moid = item.get("Moid")
    if not safe_moid(moid):
        schemaProblems.append("Catalog result " + str(index) + " has an invalid Moid.")
        continue
    if item.get("Version") != firmwareVersion:
        schemaProblems.append("Catalog result " + str(index) + " does not exactly match Firmware Version.")
        continue
    if targetType in ("Server", "UCS-X Chassis"):
        if item.get("ObjectType") != "firmware.Distributable" or item.get("ClassId") != "firmware.Distributable":
            schemaProblems.append("Distributable result " + str(index) + " has invalid discriminators.")
            continue
        supported = item.get("SupportedModels")
        modelCompatible = item.get("Model") == targetModel or (isinstance(supported, list) and targetModel in supported)
        pairs = tag_pairs(item)
        cloudCompatible = ("cisco.meta.repositorytype", "IntersightCloud") in pairs
        if targetType == "Server":
            typeCompatible = ("cisco.meta.distributabletype", target.get("distributableType")) in pairs
        else:
            typeCompatible = True
        if modelCompatible and cloudCompatible and typeCompatible:
            compatible.append(item)
    elif targetType == "Domain":
        if item.get("ObjectType") != "softwarerepository.Release" or item.get("ClassId") != "softwarerepository.Release" or item.get("Type") != "FabricSwitch":
            schemaProblems.append("FabricSwitch Release result " + str(index) + " has invalid type or discriminators.")
            continue
        supported = item.get("SupportedModels")
        requiredModels = [entry.get("Model") for entry in target.get("networkElements", []) if isinstance(entry, dict)]
        if isinstance(supported, list) and requiredModels and all(model in supported for model in requiredModels):
            compatible.append(item)

imageMoid = ""
imageObjectType = ""
requestJson = ""
submitApiUrl = ""
createdResourceUrl = ""
submitObjectType = ""
if schemaProblems:
    imageStatus = "invalid"
    imageMessage = " ".join(schemaProblems)
elif len(compatible) == 0:
    imageStatus = "not-found"
    if targetType == "Server":
        imageMessage = "No exact version/model Cisco cloud Distributable matched required tags cisco.meta.distributabletype=" + str(target.get("distributableType")) + " and cisco.meta.repositorytype=IntersightCloud."
    elif targetType == "UCS-X Chassis":
        imageMessage = "No exact version/model Cisco cloud Distributable matched cisco.meta.repositorytype=IntersightCloud. UCS-X catalog type tags remain a live-tenant readiness caveat."
    else:
        imageMessage = "No exact FabricSwitch Release supported both validated domain Fabric Interconnect models."
elif len(compatible) > 1:
    imageStatus = "ambiguous"
    imageMessage = "Multiple compatible Cisco firmware images matched the exact requested version and target compatibility contract."
else:
    image = compatible[0]
    imageStatus = "exact"
    imageMessage = "Exactly one compatible Cisco repository firmware image was validated."
    imageMoid = image["Moid"]
    imageObjectType = image["ObjectType"]
    directDownload = {"ObjectType": "firmware.DirectDownload", "ClassId": "firmware.DirectDownload", "ImageSource": "cisco"}
    if targetType == "Server":
        submitObjectType = "firmware.Upgrade"
        submitApiUrl = "/api/v1/firmware/Upgrades"
        createdResourceUrl = submitApiUrl
        directDownload["Upgradeoption"] = "upgrade_full" if prepared.get("serverUpgradeMode") == "Start Immediately" else "upgrade_mount_only"
        request = {
            "ObjectType": submitObjectType,
            "ClassId": submitObjectType,
            "UpgradeType": "direct_upgrade",
            "DirectDownload": directDownload,
            "Distributable": {"Moid": imageMoid, "ObjectType": "firmware.Distributable", "ClassId": "mo.MoRef"},
            "Server": {"Moid": targetMoid, "ObjectType": sourceObjectType, "ClassId": "mo.MoRef"},
            "SkipEstimateImpact": bool(prepared.get("skipEstimateImpact"))
        }
        exclusions = prepared.get("excludedComponents")
        if exclusions:
            request["ExcludeComponentList"] = exclusions
        pidObject = prepared.get("excludedComponentPids")
        if pidObject:
            typedPidObject = {"ObjectType": "firmware.ExcludeComponentPidListType", "ClassId": "firmware.ExcludeComponentPidListType"}
            if "ExcludeLocalDiskList" in pidObject:
                typedPidObject["ExcludeLocalDiskList"] = pidObject["ExcludeLocalDiskList"]
            if "ExcludeStorageControllerList" in pidObject:
                typedPidObject["ExcludeStorageControllerList"] = pidObject["ExcludeStorageControllerList"]
            request["ExcludeComponentPidList"] = typedPidObject
    elif targetType == "UCS-X Chassis":
        submitObjectType = "firmware.ChassisUpgrade"
        submitApiUrl = "/api/v1/firmware/ChassisUpgrades"
        createdResourceUrl = submitApiUrl
        directDownload["Upgradeoption"] = "chassis_upgrade_full"
        request = {
            "ObjectType": submitObjectType,
            "ClassId": submitObjectType,
            "UpgradeType": "direct_upgrade",
            "DirectDownload": directDownload,
            "Distributable": {"Moid": imageMoid, "ObjectType": "firmware.Distributable", "ClassId": "mo.MoRef"},
            "Chassis": {"Moid": targetMoid, "ObjectType": "equipment.Chassis", "ClassId": "mo.MoRef"},
            "XfmUpgradeOption": prepared.get("xfmUpgradeOption")
        }
        exclusions = prepared.get("excludedComponents")
        if exclusions:
            request["ExcludeComponentList"] = exclusions
    elif targetType == "Domain":
        submitObjectType = "firmware.SwitchUpgrade"
        submitApiUrl = "/api/v1/firmware/SwitchUpgrades"
        createdResourceUrl = submitApiUrl
        directDownload["Upgradeoption"] = "chassis_upgrade_full"
        networkRefs = [{"Moid": element["Moid"], "ObjectType": "network.Element", "ClassId": "mo.MoRef"} for element in target.get("networkElements", [])]
        request = {
            "ObjectType": submitObjectType,
            "ClassId": submitObjectType,
            "UpgradeType": "direct_upgrade",
            "DirectDownload": directDownload,
            "Release": {"Moid": imageMoid, "ObjectType": "softwarerepository.Release", "ClassId": "mo.MoRef"},
            "NetworkElements": networkRefs,
            "EnableFabricEvacuation": bool(prepared.get("enableFabricEvacuation")),
            "WaitTimeOut": int(prepared.get("switchWaitTimeoutMinutes")),
            "EnablePsuUpgrade": bool(prepared.get("enablePsuUpgrade")),
            "EnablePdbFpgaUpgrade": bool(prepared.get("enablePdbFpgaUpgrade")),
            "SkipWaitForIoPathConnectivity": bool(prepared.get("skipWaitForIoPathConnectivity"))
        }
    requestJson = json.dumps(request, separators=(",", ":"))

readinessCaveats = target.get("readinessCaveats") if isinstance(target.get("readinessCaveats"), list) else []
imageResultJson = json.dumps({
    "status": imageStatus,
    "message": imageMessage,
    "targetType": targetType,
    "firmwareVersion": firmwareVersion,
    "imageMoid": imageMoid or None,
    "imageObjectType": imageObjectType or None,
    "compatibleCandidateCount": len(compatible),
    "submittedImageField": "Release" if targetType == "Domain" and imageStatus == "exact" else ("Distributable" if imageStatus == "exact" else None),
    "releaseNeverPlacedInDistributable": True,
    "switchWaitTimeOutExplicitlyIncluded": targetType == "Domain" and imageStatus == "exact",
    "ciscoRepositoryOnly": True,
    "readinessCaveats": readinessCaveats
}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = imageStatus in ("not-found", "ambiguous", "invalid", "exact") and bool(imageMessage and imageResultJson) and (imageStatus != "exact" or bool(imageMoid and imageObjectType and requestJson and submitApiUrl and createdResourceUrl and submitObjectType))

properties.description: Creates one deadline and safe delays for exactly five poll attempts within the user-supplied 1-600 second bound; each delay stays below the 180-second helper timeout.
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time
timeout = int(sys.argv[1])
if timeout < 1 or timeout > 600:
    raise ValueError("Wait timeout must be between 1 and 600 seconds")
now = time.time()
initialDelay = min(2.0, max(0.25, timeout / 20.0))
pollInterval = max(1.0, max(0.0, timeout - initialDelay) / 4.0)
if initialDelay >= 180.0 or pollInterval >= 180.0:
    raise ValueError("Derived delays exceed the helper action timeout")
deadlineEpoch = "%.6f" % (now + timeout)
initialDelaySeconds = "%.6f" % initialDelay
pollIntervalSeconds = "%.6f" % pollInterval
pollingResultJson = json.dumps({"waitTimeoutSeconds": timeout, "initialDelaySeconds": initialDelay, "pollIntervalSeconds": pollInterval, "maximumPollAttempts": 5}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = bool(deadlineEpoch and initialDelaySeconds and pollIntervalSeconds and pollingResultJson)

actions.title: Wait before firmware upgrade polling attempt

properties.description: Uses the initial delay for attempt 1 and the shared interval for attempts 2-5, never sleeping past the validated firmware upgrade deadline.
properties.display_name: Wait before firmware upgrade polling attempt
properties.script:
import json
import sys
import time

deadline = float(sys.argv[1])
initialDelay = float(sys.argv[2])
pollInterval = float(sys.argv[3])
attempt = int(sys.argv[4])
if attempt < 1 or attempt > 5:
    raise ValueError("Polling attempt must be from 1 through 5")
requestedDelay = initialDelay if attempt == 1 else pollInterval
if requestedDelay < 0 or requestedDelay >= 180:
    raise ValueError("Polling delay is outside safe helper bound")
stage = "firmware upgrade poll " + str(attempt)
remaining = deadline - time.time()
if remaining <= 0:
    waitStatus = "timeout"
    waitMessage = "The firmware upgrade wait deadline was reached before " + stage + "."
    waitResultJson = json.dumps({"requestAccepted":True,"completed":False,"timeout":True,"stage":stage,"attempt":attempt}, separators=(",", ":"))
else:
    actualDelay = min(requestedDelay, remaining)
    time.sleep(actualDelay)
    waitStatus = "ready"
    waitMessage = "The bounded delay before " + stage + " completed."
    waitResultJson = json.dumps({"stage":stage,"attempt":attempt,"requestedDelaySeconds":requestedDelay,"actualDelaySeconds":actualDelay}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = waitStatus in ("ready","timeout") and bool(waitMessage and waitResultJson)

properties.description: Validates identity, documented terminal states, and response consistency for the current firmware upgrade poll.
properties.script:
import json
import re
import sys
payload = json.loads(sys.argv[1])
statusCode = int(sys.argv[2])
pollMode = sys.argv[3]
expectedMoid = sys.argv[4]
submitObjectType = sys.argv[5]
submission = json.loads(sys.argv[6])
attempt = int(sys.argv[7])

def safe_moid(value):
    return isinstance(value, str) and re.fullmatch(r"[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._~-]{0,127}", value) is not None

problems = []
observedStatus = ""
if statusCode != 200:
    problems.append("Poll response status is not documented HTTP 200.")
if not isinstance(payload, dict):
    problems.append("Poll response is not an object.")
elif payload.get("Moid") != expectedMoid or not safe_moid(payload.get("Moid")):
    problems.append("Poll response Moid does not match the exact tracked resource.")
elif pollMode == "upgrade-status":
    if payload.get("ObjectType") != "firmware.UpgradeStatus" or payload.get("ClassId") != "firmware.UpgradeStatus":
        problems.append("UpgradeStatus poll discriminators are invalid.")
    observedStatus = payload.get("Overallstatus")
    allowed = {"none", "started", "prepare initiating", "prepare initiated", "prepared", "download initiating", "download initiated", "downloading", "downloaded", "upgrade initiating on fabric A", "upgrade initiated on fabric A", "upgrading fabric A", "rebooting fabric A", "upgraded fabric A", "upgrade initiating on fabric B", "upgrade initiated on fabric B", "upgrading fabric B", "rebooting fabric B", "upgraded fabric B", "upgrade initiating", "upgrade initiated", "upgrading", "oob images staging", "oob images staged", "rebooting", "upgraded", "success", "failed", "terminated", "pending", "ReadyForCache", "Caching", "Cached", "CachingFailed"}
    if observedStatus not in allowed:
        problems.append("UpgradeStatus Overallstatus is not a documented enum.")
elif pollMode == "created-resource":
    if payload.get("ObjectType") != submitObjectType or payload.get("ClassId") != submitObjectType:
        problems.append("Created-resource poll discriminators are invalid.")
    observedStatus = payload.get("Status")
    if observedStatus not in ("NONE", "IN_PROGRESS", "SUCCESSFUL", "FAILED", "TERMINATED"):
        problems.append("Created-resource Status is not a documented uppercase enum.")
else:
    problems.append("Poll mode is invalid.")

if problems:
    pollStatus = "invalid"
    pollMessage = " ".join(problems)
elif (pollMode == "upgrade-status" and observedStatus == "success") or (pollMode == "created-resource" and observedStatus == "SUCCESSFUL"):
    pollStatus = "completed"
    pollMessage = "Firmware upgrade completion was confirmed by the exact tracked resource."
elif (pollMode == "upgrade-status" and observedStatus in ("failed", "terminated", "CachingFailed")) or (pollMode == "created-resource" and observedStatus in ("FAILED", "TERMINATED")):
    pollStatus = "failed"
    pollMessage = "The exact tracked firmware resource reported terminal failure state " + str(observedStatus) + "."
else:
    pollStatus = "in-progress"
    pollMessage = "The exact tracked firmware resource remains nonterminal at attempt " + str(attempt) + "."

pollResultJson = json.dumps({
    "status": pollStatus,
    "message": pollMessage,
    "requestAccepted": True,
    "completed": pollStatus == "completed",
    "attempt": attempt,
    "maximumPollAttempts": 5,
    "pollMode": pollMode,
    "trackedMoid": expectedMoid,
    "observedStatus": observedStatus or None,
    "createdMoid": submission.get("createdMoid"),
    "createdObjectType": submission.get("createdObjectType"),
    "targetType": submission.get("targetType"),
    "targetMoid": submission.get("targetMoid"),
    "imageMoid": submission.get("imageMoid"),
    "readinessCaveats": submission.get("readinessCaveats", []),
    "retryRequiresInspection": pollStatus in ("invalid", "failed")
}, separators=(",", ":"))
helperReady = pollStatus in ("invalid", "failed", "completed", "in-progress") and bool(pollMessage and pollResultJson)
pollTerminalMessage = "Firmware status response failed validation" if pollStatus == "invalid" else "Firmware upgrade reported terminal failure" if pollStatus == "failed" else pollMessage
